report.explanation: The alert claims degraded checkout health, but all admitted evidence is healthy: gateway logs show request_complete 200/ok, and order and payment metrics show low error rate (0.0014), p95 78ms, zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters. Topology alone proves only call paths. No current observation supports any taxonomy cause, so no bounded candidate can be stated; handing off for evidence of the actual degradation.
missing_evidence: No telemetry shows degraded checkout: gateway logs show 200/ok and order/payment metrics are healthy (p95 78ms, error_rate 0.0014).
No evidence of HTTP 500s, db pool exhaustion, redis timeouts, downstream latency, memory leak, or bad configuration.
Alert-aligned service facts and deployment facts are empty; no evidence ties any service to the reported degradation.
Need current latency/error telemetry for gateway, order, inventory, payment, and redis to locate the degraded hop.
